offres.extrait:
About the Team

At OpenAI, we are building AI systems that expand human capability and transform how work gets done. Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization brings these capabilities to customers by driving adoption, usage, and long-term value.

We are hiring a GTM Strategy & Operations, Strategic Programs lead to help drive OpenAI's highest-priority GTM programs from strategy through execution. This role sits at the center of complex, cross-functional work across Sales, Product, Marketing, Product Marketing, Operations, Enablement, Finance, Communications, and leadership.

This is a high-leverage role for someone who can turn ambiguous priorities into clear plans, align stakeholders, keep execution moving, and build the operating systems that help the GTM organization scale. You will help ensure our most important programs have clear ownership, strong coordination, customer and field signal, and measurable business impact.

About the Team 
 The Corporate Development team at DoorDash is a fast-paced, high-performing group responsible for sourcing, evaluating, negotiating and executing M&A and investments. This team is central to DoorDash’s continued growth. We work closely with senior leadership, operations, product and finance teams to guide company strategy. We lead all aspects of identifying, evaluating, and executing transactions that have a significant impact on the overall direction of the company.
 About the Role 
 You will help identify and execute transformative acquisitions and investments globally that accelerate or increase the likelihood of DoorDash achieving its strategic objectives. You will report to the Senior Director, Corporate Development. This role is remote first with some domestic and international travel expected.

offres.titre: CHARGE DE CONTENUS AUDIOVISUELS-MULTIMEDIAS & STRATEGIE NUMERIQUE - Mairie de ATHIS-MONS
offres.extrait:
Employeur : Communes
Sous la responsabilité du Directeur de la communication, l’agent conçoit, produit et diffuse les contenus audiovisuels et multimédias de la Ville.
